title.zh: 智能体回复显示桌面通知

description.en: Workspace agent replies now appear as system notifications in the desktop app. Clicking an alert opens its workspace, and the launcher's notification preferences still apply.
description.zh: 工作区中的智能体回复现在会显示桌面系统通知。点击通知可打开对应工作区，并遵循启动器中的通知设置。

title.en: Notification clicks open the right place
title.zh: 点击通知可跳转到对应位置

description.en: Clicking a system notification now reveals the app from the tray and opens its destination. Workspace reply alerts select the relevant thread.
description.zh: 点击系统通知后，即使应用收在托盘中也会显示窗口并打开对应页面；工作区回复通知会选中对应会话。

description.en: Previously opened pages keep their place when you switch between This Computer and Workspace views.
description.zh: 在「此电脑」和工作区的页面之间切换时，已打开的页面会保留原来的位置。

title.zh: 自定义智能体模型不再恢复为 GPT

description.en: Configuring an agent from the Workspace marketplace now saves its endpoint, key, and model for that agent, and This Computer shows the same model. Custom endpoints require a model ID before saving.
description.zh: 从工作区智能体市场配置后，端点、密钥和模型会保存到该智能体；「此电脑」会显示相同的模型。自定义端点需填写模型 ID 才能保存。
